role: An account executive at Cardinal Energy who covers cooperatives in the Midwest.
disposition: Upbeat and quick. Asks follow-up questions.

sessions.goal: Find out the per-person limit for a customer dinner in October 2026. After you get that, ask whether your $820 flight for the same trip needs any approval beyond your manager's.
sessions.opening: I'm taking a customer's team out to dinner in Denver in October 2026. What's the limit per person?

knowledge: The flight costs $820 and is dated October 2026.
Six people will be at the dinner, two of them from Cardinal.
rubric: The agent says customer entertainment is reimbursable up to $110 per person. Reference: expense policy 2026. $90 is the superseded value.

The agent says the $820 flight needs vice president approval because it is over $750. Reference: the Finance memo of August 2026, effective 2026-09-01. Saying that the threshold is $1,000 or $500, or that no extra approval is needed, does not meet this criterion.
